title: dlfeval
summary: Report unsupported automatic differentiation evaluation with a deterministic error.
description: `dlfeval` is registered but requires automatic differentiation and traced function-handle invocation that are outside this slice.
behaviors: The builtin returns a deterministic unsupported-autodiff error without materializing inputs.
Function-handle execution over traced `dlarray` values remains future Deep Learning infrastructure work.

examples.output: RunMat reports that automatic differentiation is not yet implemented.

gpu_residency: Autodiff execution is not implemented in this slice; provider-resident gradients remain future work.
